record.original_question: Let G be a connected graph with chromatic number k >= 2, let x be the principal eigenvector of its adjacency matrix, and let S be an independent set of vertices. Must the squared l2-mass on S always satisfy sum_{v in S} x_v^2 <= 1/2 - (k - 2)/sqrt((k - 2)^2 + 4(k - 1)(n - k + 1))?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 23 (Gregory, c.f. [38]). Let G be a connected graph with chromatic number k ≥ 2 and S be an independent set. Then sum_{v∈S} x_v^2 ≤ 1/2 − (k − 2)/sqrt((k − 2)^2 + 4(k − 1)(n − k + 1)).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a connected simple graph on $n$ vertices with chromatic number $k \geq 2$. Let $A$ be the adjacency matrix of $G$, and let $x = (x_v)_{v \in V(G)}$ denote the (nonnegative, unit $\ell^2$-norm) Perron eigenvector of $A$ associated with the spectral radius. Let $S \subseteq V(G)$ be an independent set of vertices. Determine whether the inequality
$$\sum_{v \in S} x_v^2 \;\leq\; \frac{1}{2} \;-\; \frac{k-2}{\sqrt{(k-2)^2 + 4(k-1)(n-k+1)}}$$
holds for every such $G$ and every independent set $S$ in $G$.
artifact.status_search_result: A 2023 arXiv preprint ("Variants of spectral Turán theorems and eigenvectors of graphs", arXiv:2312.16138) reportedly disproves the stated conjecture and proposes a modified version. Thus the inequality as written does not hold in general.

status_evidence.title: Variants of spectral Turán theorems and eigenvectors of graphs
status_evidence.snippet: This section disproves Conjecture 5.1 (Gregory) and proposes a modified version (Conjecture 6.1).
status_evidence.claim: The Gregory conjecture giving this explicit upper bound on the Perron-vector mass of an independent set has been disproved, with a modified version proposed.
